questions.questionText: hour 15 minutes You must answer on the multiple choice answer sheet. questions.questionText: Bacteria were grown in a medium containing 15N. After several generations, all of the bacterial DNA contained 15N. The DNA of some of these bacteria was extracted and analysed. This DNA was all hybrid DNA containing equal amounts of 14N and 15N. HbA CTGACTCCTGAGGAGAAGTCT HbS CTGACTCCTGTGGAGAAGTCT Both the polypeptides for HbA and HbS are the same length. How will the mutation in the allele result in the production of an altered version of the β-globin polypeptide?

options.D: The ribosome will be unable to continue translation of the HbS mRNA after the altered codon.
